mentions.name: 300-litre planted freshwater aquarium
mentions.description: A 300 litre planted freshwater aquarium set up in the living room, stocked with soil, live plants, snails, cardinal tetras, and amano shrimp. The setup involved a 6-week tank cycling period with water monitoring, and ongoing care includes fertilising, plant trimming, feeding, and water changes every couple of weeks.
mentions.source_excerpt: I bought a 300 litre aquarium about 6 weeks ago for the living room. Added soil, plants and water. Have spent the last 6 weeks watching plants grow, and snails that smuggled in on plants, multiply.
